project-charter.title: Project Charter

cards.title: Client Context
cards.body: A service workshop wants to review side stand stability for commuter motorcycles parked on typical urban surfaces.

cards.title: Professional Responsibility
cards.body: A side stand failure can damage the vehicle and injure users. Recommendations must consider safety, manufacturability, and field use.

project-charter.acceptanceText: I accept the project charter and will document engineering reasoning.

cards.title: Stability Background
cards.body: A motorcycle on a side stand remains stable when the combined center of gravity projects within the support polygon formed by the tires and stand foot.

cards.title: Design Focus
cards.body: Consider compressive load, bending tendency, pivot support, return spring, and ground contact.

stability-principle.title: Stability Principle
stability-principle.prompt: Explain how side stand geometry helps keep a motorcycle stable when parked.

mcq.question: Which factor most directly affects whether the parked motorcycle tips over?
options: Support polygon and center of gravity projection

material-decision.title: Material Decision
material-decision.prompt: Compare possible materials for the side stand and recommend one.

options.title: Mild Steel
options.note: Economical and easy to fabricate for common stands.

options.title: Aluminium Alloy
options.note: Lightweight but may require larger section and careful design.

options.title: Polymer Composite
options.note: Lightweight but requires validation for impact and creep.

questions: How would you improve this design?
